title: Installment Plan Cancellation Charge on Owner Auto Policy Nonpayment Cancellations
content:
**Rule.** On a cancellation of an Owner Auto Policy term for nonpayment, an installment-plan cancellation charge is withheld from the return premium. It is charged each time a cancellation closes the term's installment plan. The amount is set by the term's billing plan under the Installment Payment Plans. When the term has more than one plan, the plan entered first is used.

| Billing plan of the term | Charge withheld |
|---|---|
| Cardinal Point Two-Pay Plan | 15.00 |
| Cardinal Point Four-Pay Plan | 15.00 |
| Cardinal Point Six-Pay Direct Bill Plan | 15.00 |
| Cardinal Point Monthly EFT Plan | 7.50 |
| Cardinal Point Monthly Card Autopay Plan | 7.50 |
| Any other plan | nothing |

The charge is subtracted from the pro rata unearned premium. The return premium is never below 0.00.

**Reading the table (hypothetical).**
- A term billed on the Cardinal Point Paid-in-Full Plan is on none of the plans listed, so nothing is withheld.
- A term billed on the Cardinal Point Monthly EFT Plan has 7.50 withheld at each cancellation for nonpayment that closes its plan.
